caption: Nikola Jokic had 37 points, 18 rebounds and 11 assists for the 202nd triple-double of his career, and Jamal Murray scored a season-high 45 as the Denver Nuggets beat the Chicago Bulls 151-145 in overtime.

beats.caption: Nikola Jokic recorded the 202nd triple-double of his career as the Denver Nuggets visited the Chicago Bulls.

beats.label: POINTS
beats.caption: Nikola Jokic scored 37 points, grabbed 18 rebounds and handed out 11 assists.

beats.label: WESTBROOK'S RECORD
beats.caption: Nikola Jokic is now seven triple-doubles shy of Russell Westbrook's NBA record of 209.

beats.text: BULLS TIED IT WITH 7 SECONDS LEFT
beats.caption: Buddy Hield stole the ball from Nikola Jokic and Josh Giddey's layup tied it at 131, forcing overtime.
Jamal Murray scored eight of his season-high 45 points in overtime as the Denver Nuggets won 151-145.
